canonicalOrigin: Start of usable floor boundary at floor structural bottom; run+X, interior+Y
usablePrismRule: No native triangle area or collision volume atY>0 betweenZ.1875and2.6875; floor/roof bearing contact exceptions exist only within declared slab heights.
completeExportRule: Every exported triangle fits declared reserved footprint and height, including handles, trim and native joined contacts; no recentering/scaling/placement compensation.
cornerUsableRule: No native triangle area or collision volume atX>0ANDY>0 betweenZ.1875and2.6875. Corner contact ears are recessed from visible top planes.
armorMountRule: Named outward normals and surface positions; a future qualified62.5mm mate/spacer must be separately authored. No automatic strength, fastening or armor rating.
collisionRepresentation: Separate source contact proxies and actual native CSG qualification; no automatic runtime collider/damage installation.
damageMode: structural voxel damage required but not implemented by these visual assets
